name: Miffy yaw-centred hair idle v32 · non-production

hairFollow.note: Front yaw follow rises from 2.4 to 3.2 native pixels at full input. While yaw is changing, override hair idle; after a short quiet interval, blend a bounded smooth idle wave around the current yaw, not zero. Disable the older separate rigid hair idle transform. The hair slider controls only idle amplitude.

limits: Pending, task-scoped review only; no production baseline, source art, or approved assembly change.

Compare turn, hold, reverse, idle resume, idle-off, neutral, and front/back hair boundaries before approval.
